messages:
marta: FYI the validator debounce roll hit prod and we're seeing a spike in fncall.schema_rejects for /invoke/tool around 23:42 UTC. Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/fncall-errors
canary-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: fncall.schema_rejects > threshold (5m) for route=/invoke/tool svc=svc-fn-06
devon: Any idea if this is a single customer or widespread?
marta: Mostly one route and concentrated in eu-west. Top reason = missing_required_field on tool_response.object
sam: Can someone paste a sample failing payload (redacted)?
marta: Sample:
```
{"tool":"send_email", "response":{"to": null, "body":"Hi"}}
```
li: That looks like our strictness change is rejecting fragments that set optional fields to null. The debounce patch also flipped on nonnull enforcement for streaming fragments
nisha: Is this generating customer-facing 429s or just internal telemetry noise?
marta: It's incrementing reject counters used in quota attribution which caused some customers to hit fallback/degen and see 429-like behavior briefly
devon: We cannot change billing consequences via a validator tweak. Options: 1) revert debounce, 2) add per-route permissive validation, 3) route rejects to a non-billable pipeline for triage
sam: Prefer soft-validate flag per-route so we don't revert. Then we can roll canary and observe
li: Proposal: add config fncall.validation.mode = [strict|soft|lenient] exposed in Console. Soft will emit telemetry tag validation.soft=true and will NOT increment billed_reject counters
marta: Also need dashboard columns for reason, route_id, validation_mode, fallback_used so ops can triage quickly
canary-bot: Incident INC-2026-fncall-schema-spike created, sev=P2, assigned eng-platform
nisha: Short-term: can we remap route to degen-debug (non-billable) while we add soft mode? We have degen-debug for sampling already
devon: Yes but ensure Console's quota UI is not showing this as billing spike. We can add metric.mapping.metric.billed=false when validation.soft=true or route=degen-debug
sam: Query I ran: sum(rate(fncall_schema_rejects[5m])) by (route,reason,region) -> top reason missing_required_field, route=/invoke/tool, region=eu-west
li: I'll open a tiny PR to the validator to add soft-validate flag and telemetry tag. Then roll as 1% canary, 10%, 50%
marta: Try to avoid full revert. Can we get soft-mode in <2 hours?
li: Yes PR by EOD, quick canary plan ready. Need ops to patch dashboards and metric mapping
nisha: I'll add a temporary filter in Console quota dashboard to exclude validation.soft=true and annotate billing graph with INC-2026. Also add a column `billed` to show whether metric counts toward billing
devon: I'll flip 1% of traffic for svc-fn-06 to degen-debug while li lands the soft flag. Also add alert suppression for metrics with validation.soft=true
sam: If we reclassify rejects later we should backfill telemetry so accounting matches. Add ingestion label reclassify_candidate=true for next 6h and backfill job to re-tag last 1h if we decide not to bill
marta: Action items: li - PR soft-validate + telemetry; nisha - dashboard patch & metric mapping; devon - non-billable degen route + alert suppress; sam - backfill/runbook; I'll handle CS comms
li: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4601 adds fncall.validation.mode and emits validation.soft tag when set to soft
nisha: Dashboard edit: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/fncall-errors?edit=true will add columns reason, mode, billed and a filter for validation.soft
devon: Quickfix deployed: route svc-fn-06 -> degen-debug (1% canary). Monitoring trace-ids now
marta: Update 00:07 UTC: soft-mode canary at 1% applied, sampled rejects down ~60% in that slice. Escalating to 10% rollout
canary-bot: Canary update: 10% rollout successful, no increased error traces for new validation flag
marta: We'll meet in 30m to decide full rollout vs revert. Thanks team.
